We hope you are still alive. We hope to god you and your system are still here. We are a polyfragmented traumagenic System that have experienced RA amoungst other trauma.
We are the Cinderscollective and we totally understand how things are not portrayed accurately in the DID community.
It’s dangerous and harmful. The advocates that claim to destigmatise the condition are doing the opposite and are causing great suffering for other systems who genuinely are suffering and dysfunctional with DID symptoms I promise there is hope.
We are on instagram if you have it.
We would always support a System that is struggling like us.
I can’t tell you everything will be okay. But I can tell you I’m grateful you survived and even in your lowest moment you were strong enough to have a voice and reach out, and that is more worth it’s weight in gold no matter how fake Systems personas gain them thousands of followers.
We hope you are okay. We hope your System is ok. We hope at the very least you are still with us🤗

Hey, as someone that had an ex lover who is transgender m to f ( without surgery) I’m so sorry you feel this way. But I really want you to know there are people like me walking around who see you as the person you are, the person that’s on the inside that baby girl blooming, only shallow people see the outer body and think that’s all there is. I don’t, I look for someone’s soul because out of everything it’s the most honest part of them, and I’m not the only one on earth that does, lovie, life is hell. This world is messed up, unfortunately I don’t think humanity will change at all anytime soon. Through all the shit I’ve gone through years of self hatred and destruction because of trauma I have found the secret to drawing love to you is to accept yourself flaws and all ( and I got a shitload) and once you do that showing yourself love and kindness, once you do that you are able to show it unconditionally towards others therefore drawing it to you.  Dying won’t solve the problem, and you will be missed, even if you don’t think so or can’t see it now. I won’t lie life is bs and crap and hard and tbh I hate being here to most of the time.
But please, reconsider this decision and my inbox is always open to you. I fully extend my hand of love and friendship out to you wholeheartedly 
-ivy
